items.title: Show HN: OpenComputer – an open source alternative to Devin
items.summary: 📝 The open-source Devin alternative: a coding agent your team works with in Slack, on its own computers, in your cloud or ours. The VM runs the gateway, Calvin: a thin bridge that listens for Slack events and starts a session with Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode, depending on your configuration. Each session is isolated with rootless Podman.🔗 Read more: https://github.com/diggerhq/opencomputer
